services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Aerial views of Miami's match venues and iconic skyline. The perfect flight before or after the game. Miami is the center of the soccer world this summer! And the best way to see it is from above. This private 20-minute helicopter tour takes you over Hard Rock Stadium, home to the biggest matches of 2026, and the iconic Miami skyline, giving you a perspective no stadium seat can offer. Schedule your flight before or after the match for the ultimate start or finish to a legendary day in Miami. Your private helicopter fits up to 3 passengers. Bose A30 noise-canceling headsets, air-conditioned cabin, and a pilot who brings every landmark to life with commentary throughout the flight. Price
